method: paired_selftest.sh <commit> <before ref> <label>: a fresh `git clone --shared` checked out at <commit>; the selftest runs first with <before ref>'s scripts/check_spec_reconciliation.py written over the checkout (HEAD unchanged, so both witness records name the same commit), then with the commit's own file; SELFTEST_WORKERS=4, TMPDIR under ~/.tmp. The host is shared with other lanes; the load average at the end of each run is recorded beside its wall. Pairs p1, p2 and full ran the script's first form (`pair7.sh <commit> <before ref> <label>`, repository and work directory fixed in the script); pair merged ran its current form, `paired_selftest.sh <repository> <commit> <before ref> <work directory>`, which also compares stdout.

notes: Pairs p1, p2 and full bind c9da8e56b and earlier, before the merge of origin/main and the R7RKX repairs; pair merged binds the landing file (6d3f8f2a1, file sha 5e812d69...), against origin/main 4b86e4285's file, which added figplan_cases (792 witness entries, 639 mutants and 153 controls).

Pair merged ran on a heavily shared host (load 14 at the end of before, 34 at the end of after), so its walls are one noisy sample each; the full pair (865 s to 230 s at load ~1-4) is the cleaner wall comparison.
The witness for pair merged is retained gzipped: witness-merged-6d3f8f2a1.json.gz (its gunzipped sha256 is the pair's after.witnessSha256). Earlier pairs keep digests only.

Rule-6 kills for this change are by scripts/test_reconciliation_pool.py alone (pool-mutation-2026-11-27.json, withSelftest false); the earlier scope-family-mutation-2026-11-26.json kills were by the synthetic harness alone.
